items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We had a nice little group together. We had a little bass player from home named

ctx.x: So anyway, I got back to gigging around Detroit. And before long, my grandmother passed, and I went back to the funeral. And while I was there, some friends of mine that I had played with, one in particular that I didn't mention, who had played with the Doc Palmer Orchestra, the first orchestra I played with, Jack Scott, the guitarist... And there was an alto saxophone player with Don Dunbar's orchestra, Bolden(?) Townsend, and his wife, Micki Gwynn(?), who had also played the piano and sang with the Don Dunbar…
